abstract: Three ovarian neoplasms (choriocarcinoma, yolk sac carcinoma, and teratoma) were diagnosed in a 2 yr carcinogenicity study involving B6C3F1 mice. The yolk sac carcinoma and the teratoma occurred in opposite ovaries of a single female mouse that was sacrificed in extremis on study day 725. The choriocarcinoma occurred in a female mouse that was sacrificed in extremis on study day 565. These neoplasms were considered to be spontaneous in origin.
abstract_ja: 2年間の発がん性試験を行ったB6C3F1マウスにおいて、3つの卵巣腫瘍(絨毛癌、卵黄嚢癌、奇形腫)が診断された。卵黄嚢癌と奇形腫は同一マウスの反対側の卵巣に生じた。絨毛癌は別のマウスに生じた。いずれのマウスも瀕死の状態で安楽死され、これらの腫瘍は自然発生によるものと考えられた。
